title: Cucumber Dill Salad (Easy, Crunchy & Vinegar-Based)
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldKeywords: cucumber, cucumber onion salad, cucumber salad, cucumber salad with vinegar, dill cucumber salad, potluck sidedish, summer salad, vinegar cucumber salad
ldIngredientsRaw: 4 tablespoons rice vinegar (or white wine vinegar)
Freshly ground black pepper (to taste (I like lots))
ldInstructionsRaw: Mix the salad: In the bottom of a large bowl, whisk the vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Add the cucumber, red onion, and dill, and toss very well until everything is evenly coated.
Chill (optional but recommended): For best flavor, let the salad rest in the fridge for 10–20 minutes before serving. Toss again, taste, and add more salt and pepper if needed.
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ ½ small red onion, very thinly sliced
▢ 4 tablespoons rice vinegar, or white wine vinegar
▢ ¾ teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
▢ Freshly ground black pepper, to taste (I like lots)
